agent_notes: עָבַר is singular with plural הַמַּיִם. Meiri and Radak cite Numbers 19:13 for the pattern, and Ibn Ezra reads it as picking up the singular נחל of v. 4. I kept the singular 'it had passed' in the literal layer.

הַזֵּידוֹנִים occurs only here in the Hebrew Bible (HALOT, BDB). The root is זיד, 'to seethe' or 'boil up', which gives 'seething' or 'raging' here and 'insolent' in the related זָדוֹן. The English versions split between 'proud' (KJV, ASV, YLT) and 'waters of pride' (BBE). I chose 'seething' for the literal layer to keep the sense of foaming that the water image needs.
